answer: A bond of 32% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in shale, and atlas reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 81 aliases, and each one needs its own funded grove account. A farm of 2980 identities would post 4291 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
